_doc: Second step of sign-in. POST /api/auth/login answers mfa_required (NO token: no session exists yet) for a user with an authenticator or the email method, or when two-step sign-in is required and the address is verified. Answer it with POST /api/auth/login/mfa {challenge, method: totp|recovery|email, code}. method email first needs POST /api/auth/login/mfa/email {challenge} (202 {resendAfter: 60}). Wrong codes on these anonymous steps are 401 (code_invalid with attemptsLeft; challenge_expired restarts at the password step); five wrong codes per challenge, ten minutes, 3 mails per challenge. mfa_enrollment_required carries a TOKEN of a restricted session: send the user to the two-factor setup (me.restriction is mfa_enrollment). The client never stores a challenge beyond the screen; codes are typed by the user (no client-side TOTP).

body.message: This code has expired or was tried too often. Ask for a new one.
Two-step sign-in is required here: sign in with your password.
